body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Bliss by Beaulieu introduced its new Flirtation line at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5.

For sophisticated tastes and trend-setting design sense, Bliss Flirtation comes in 10 new carpet styles representing 288 SKU's. Flirtation is a first for Beaulieu because it uses variable twist technology in a pattern carpet made with Beaulieu's PermaSoft and PermaSoft Plus nylon. The results are those of a higher-end pattern carpet.
(Photo: Patricia Flavin, Senior Vice President, Marketing at the Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas)
